description: How does this country's education system measure up?. Latest measured education indicators for 209 countries (literacy, enrolment at each level, completion, spending, pupils per teacher, out-of-school children, R&D spend, researchers, tertiary gender parity), each with its year and World Bank series code, plus the number of research and education institutions in the country (OpenAlex, all with ROR ids). Compare up to 6 countries or rank all countries on one indicator. Facts only; no personal data. Routes: /rank (indicator, since, limit); /answer (country*); /compare (countries*); /coverage. Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /rank, /answer, /compare, /coverage. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
